title: Intra-Asia rates soften as congestion at major ports begins to ease
content:
Intra-Asia rates are receding from their recent highs as bottlenecks in major Chinese and other Asian ports subside.
On 15 October, Drewry’s Intra-Asia Container Index dipped 3%, to an average of $1,453 per 40ft.

title: Hi-tech cargo powers K+N growth as DSV rebuilds volumes
content:
Semiconductor and cloud infrastructure shipments helped drive almost 10% growth in Kuehne + Nagel’s third-quarter airfreight volumes, contrasting with falling tonnage at rival DSV, as it pruned accounts and managed Schenker integration effects.
